senses.gloss: to have a wish/desire; to make a testament/last will

stems.sensesRaw: to have a wish/desire; to make a testament/last will

examples.turoyo: Omar: “Hul d kətno saġ (gmaqweno ak qawetyatayḏi  ʕal ann abnayḏi stene) tark didux lǝgbǝn (= lobǝn). Towat hat waziro, hul d kətna saġ, towat waziro hat.”
examples.translation: He said: “As long as I am alive..., I will commit my instructions [by means of testament] also to my sons, they will not leave you [lit.: give your leaving]. You shall be vizier, as long as we are alive, you shall be vizier.”
examples.raw:
Omar: “Hul d kətno saġ (gmaqweno ak qawetyatayḏi  ʕal ann abnayḏi stene) tark didux lǝgbǝn (= lobǝn). Towat hat waziro, hul d kətna saġ, towat waziro hat.”
He said: “As long as I am alive..., I will commit my instructions [by means of testament] also to my sons, they will not leave you [lit.: give your leaving]. You shall be vizier, as long as we are alive, you shall be vizier.”
(NI_Sultan_Wesir_und_Barbar p. 3, 8: 18)
